items.source: Compatible with GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini, GPT-4 Turbo and all GPT-3.5 Turbo models newer than gpt-3.5-turbo-1106. The JSON_OBJECT type enables JSON mode, which guarantees the message the model generates is valid JSON. The JSON_SCHEMA type enables Structured Outputs which guarantees the model will match your supplied JSON schema. The JSON_SCHEMA type requires setting the responseFormat.schema property as well.

items.source: The OpenAI User Message API can incorporate a list of base64-encoded audio files with the message. Spring AI’s Message interface facilitates multimodal AI models by introducing the Media type. This type encompasses data and details regarding media attachments in messages, utilizing Spring’s org.springframework.util.MimeType and a org.springframework.core.io.Resource for the raw media data. Currently, OpenAI support only the following media types: audio/mp3 and audio/wav.
items.translation: OpenAI 的 User Message API 可以将一组 base64 编码的音频文件包含在消息中。 Spring AI 的 Message 接口通过引入 Media 类型来支持多模态 AI 模型。 该类型包含了消息中媒体附件的数据和详情，并利用 Spring 的 org.springframework.util.MimeType 以及用于原始媒体数据的 org.springframework.core.io.Resource。 目前，OpenAI 仅支持以下媒体类型：audio/mp3 和 audio/wav。

This type encompasses data and details regarding media attachments in messages, utilizing Spring’s org.springframework.util.MimeType and a org.springframework.core.io.Resource for the raw media data. Currently, OpenAI support only the following audio types: audio/mp3 and audio/wav.
items.translation: OpenAI 的 Assistant Message API 可以包含与消息一起发送的 base64 编码音频文件列表。 Spring AI 的 Message 接口通过引入 Media 类型来支持多模态 AI 模型。 该类型包含了消息中媒体附件的数据和详情，并利用 Spring 的 org.springframework.util.MimeType 以及用于原始媒体数据的 org.springframework.core.io.Resource。 目前，OpenAI 仅支持以下音频类型：audio/mp3 和 audio/wav。

items.source: Name of the OpenAI chat model to use. You can select between models such as: gpt-5-mini, gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4-turbo, gpt-3.5-turbo, and more. See the models page for more information.

items.source: When using GPT-5 models such as gpt-5, gpt-5-mini, and gpt-5-nano, the temperature parameter is not supported. These models are optimized for reasoning and do not use temperature. Specifying a temperature value will result in an error. In contrast, conversational models like gpt-5-chat do support the temperature parameter.
items.translation: 在使用 gpt-5、gpt-5-mini 和 gpt-5-nano 等 GPT-5 模型时，不支持 temperature 参数。 这些模型针对推理进行了优化，不使用 temperature。 指定 temperature 值将导致错误。 相比之下，像 gpt-5-chat 这样的对话模型支持 temperature 参数。

items.source: Controls which (if any) function is called by the model. none means the model will not call a function and instead generates a message. auto means the model can pick between generating a message or calling a function. Specifying a particular function via {"type: "function", "function": {"name": "my_function"}} forces the model to call that function. none is the default when no functions are present. auto is the default if functions are present.
items.translation: 控制模型调用哪个（如果有的话）函数。none 表示模型不会调用函数，而是生成消息。auto 表示模型可以在生成消息和调用函数之间进行选择。通过 {"type: "function", "function": {"name": "my_function"}} 指定特定函数会强制模型调用该函数。如果没有提供任何函数，默认值为 none。如果存在函数，默认值为 auto。

items.source: The OpenAI User Message API can incorporate a list of base64-encoded images or image urls with the message. Spring AI’s Message interface facilitates multimodal AI models by introducing the Media type. This type encompasses data and details regarding media attachments in messages, utilizing Spring’s org.springframework.util.MimeType and a org.springframework.core.io.Resource for the raw media data.
items.translation: OpenAI 的 User Message API 可以将 base64 编码的图像列表或图像 URL 与消息一起包含。 Spring AI 的 Message 接口通过引入 Media 类型来支持多模态 AI 模型。 该类型包含了消息中媒体附件的数据和详情，并利用 Spring 的 org.springframework.util.MimeType 以及用于原始媒体数据的 org.springframework.core.io.Resource。

items.source: Chat-model layer. A gen_ai.client.operation observation wraps every call to OpenAiChatModel.call(…​) or .stream(…​), carrying request parameters, response metadata, and token usage. See the observability reference for the full set of tags and metrics.
items.translation: Chat-model 层。 一个 gen_ai.client.operation 观测值会包裹对 OpenAiChatModel.call(…​) 或 .stream(…​) 的每一次调用，并携带请求参数、响应元数据以及 token 使用情况。请参阅 可观测性参考 以获取完整的标签和指标列表。

items.source: For streaming calls, the okhttp.requests span fires and is recorded in the registry, the timer is recorded in MeterRegistry, and traceparent is still propagated on the outbound request — but the span is not nested under the chat-model span. This is because the OpenAI SDK’s async streaming implementation hops onto ForkJoinPool.commonPool() before invoking Spring AI’s HTTP client, dropping the calling thread’s observation context at that boundary. Spring AI cannot recover the context from within its HTTP-client wrapper.
items.translation: 对于流式调用，okhttp.requests span 会触发并记录在注册表中，计时器记录在 MeterRegistry 中，且 traceparent 仍会传播到出站请求中——但该 span 并未嵌套在 chat-model span 下。 这是因为 OpenAI SDK 的异步流式实现会在调用 Spring AI 的 HTTP 客户端之前跳转到 ForkJoinPool.commonPool()，从而在那个边界处丢失了调用线程的观测上下文（observation context）。 Spring AI 无法在其 HTTP 客户端包装器内部恢复该上下文。

items.source: When using a local Docker Model Runner that exposes an OpenAI-compatible API, you may need to append /v1 to your base URL if the server expects it. For example: spring.ai.openai.chat.base-url=http://localhost:12434/engines/v1 instead of localhost:12434/engines.
items.translation: 当使用暴露 OpenAI 兼容 API 的本地 Docker Model Runner 时，如果服务器要求，您可能需要在基础 URL 后添加 /v1。 例如：使用 spring.ai.openai.chat.base-url=http://localhost:12434/engines/v1 而不是 localhost:12434/engines。

items.source: User-controlled tool execution — use DefaultToolCallingManager directly when you need full control over the loop (for example, when combining tool calling with direct ChatModel access).
items.translation: 用户控制的工具执行 — 当您需要完全控制循环时（例如，当将工具调用与直接访问 ChatModel 结合使用时），请直接使用 DefaultToolCallingManager。

items.source: Use this pattern when you need direct access to the ChatModel API and want full control over the tool-call loop. Invoke ChatModel directly without ToolCallingAdvisor; check for tool calls yourself and drive the loop using ToolCallingManager.
items.translation: 当您需要直接访问 ChatModel API 并希望完全控制工具调用循环（tool-call loop）时，请使用此模式。 直接调用 ChatModel 而不使用 ToolCallingAdvisor；自行检查工具调用，并使用 ToolCallingManager 来驱动循环。

items.source: OpenAI models that offer vision multimodal support include gpt-4, gpt-4o, and gpt-4o-mini. Refer to the Vision guide for more information.

items.source: The OpenAiChatModel implements the ChatModel and StreamingChatModel and uses the [low-level-api] to connect to the OpenAI service.
items.translation: OpenAiChatModel 实现了 ChatModel 和 StreamingChatModel，并使用 [low-level-api] 连接到 OpenAI 服务。

items.source: Spring AI can additionally bind OkHttp connection-pool gauges (okhttp.pool.connection.count with state=active|idle and client.kind=sync|async) to the application’s MeterRegistry. These are secondary telemetry — useful for capacity tuning but not required for tracing or per-request latency — so they’re disabled by default.
items.translation: Spring AI 还可以将 OkHttp 连接池指标（带有 state=active|idle 和 client.kind=sync|async 的 okhttp.pool.connection.count）绑定到应用程序的 MeterRegistry。 这些是次要遥测数据——对于容量调优很有用，但对于链路追踪或单次请求延迟并非必需——因此它们默认处于禁用状态。

items.source: Spring AI uses the official openai-java SDK under the hood and configures its HTTP transport with a custom OkHttp client built by SpringAiOpenAiHttpClient.Builder. You can intercept that builder before the underlying OkHttpClient is created by exposing one or more OpenAiHttpClientBuilderCustomizer beans. Each customizer receives the same builder used by every OpenAI model (chat, embedding, image, audio, moderation), so the customization applies uniformly.
items.translation: Spring AI 在底层使用官方的 openai-java SDK，并使用由 SpringAiOpenAiHttpClient.Builder 构建的自定义 OkHttp 客户端来配置其 HTTP 传输。 您可以通过暴露一个或多个 OpenAiHttpClientBuilderCustomizer 类型的 Bean，在底层的 OkHttpClient 创建之前拦截该构建器。 每个自定义器都会接收到所有 OpenAI 模型（chat、embedding、image、audio、moderation）所使用的相同构建器，因此自定义配置将统一应用于所有模型。

items.source: Starting from version 2.0.0-M5, Spring AI uses the official openai-java SDK under the hood for all OpenAI models. The transition is expected to be seamless and there are no breaking changes for existing users of the OpenAI API properties and builders. If you find any issues, please report them to us at Spring AI GitHub Issues.
items.translation: 从版本 2.0.0-M5 开始，Spring AI 在底层为所有 OpenAI 模型使用官方的 openai-java SDK。此次过渡预计是无缝的，对于现有 OpenAI API 属性和构建器的用户来说，不会有任何破坏性变更。如果您发现任何问题，请通过 Spring AI GitHub Issues 向我们报告。

items.source: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the chat completion. The total length of input tokens and generated tokens is limited by the model’s context length. Use for non-reasoning models (e.g., gpt-4o, gpt-3.5-turbo). Cannot be used with reasoning models (e.g., o1, o3, o4-mini series). Mutually exclusive with maxCompletionTokens - setting both will result in an API error.
items.translation: 在聊天补全中可生成的最大 token 数量。输入 token 和生成 token 的总长度受限于模型的上下文长度。用于非推理模型（例如 gpt-4o, gpt-3.5-turbo）。不可与推理模型配合使用（例如 o1, o3, o4-mini 系列）。与 maxCompletionTokens 互斥——同时设置两者将导致 API 错误。

items.source: An upper bound for the number of tokens that can be generated for a completion, including visible output tokens and reasoning tokens. Required for reasoning models (e.g., o1, o3, o4-mini series). Cannot be used with non-reasoning models (e.g., gpt-4o, gpt-3.5-turbo). Mutually exclusive with maxTokens - setting both will result in an API error.
items.translation: 可用于补全生成的 token 数量上限，包括可见输出 token 和推理 token。推理模型必填（例如 o1、o3、o4-mini 系列）。不可用于非推理模型（例如 gpt-4o、gpt-3.5-turbo）。与 maxTokens 互斥——同时设置两者将导致 API 错误。

items.source: Output types that you would like the model to generate for this request. Most models are capable of generating text, which is the default. The gpt-audio model can also be used to generate audio. To request that this model generate both text and audio responses, you can use: text, audio. Not supported for streaming.
items.translation: 输出您希望模型针对此请求生成的类型。大多数模型都能够生成文本，这是默认选项。 gpt-audio 模型还可以用于生成音频。若要请求该模型同时生成文本和音频响应， 您可以使用：text、audio。不支持流式传输。

items.source: Audio parameters for the audio generation. Required when audio output is requested with output-modalities: audio. Requires the gpt-audio model and is is not supported for streaming completions.
items.translation: 用于音频生成的音频参数。当请求的 output-modalities 为 audio 时需要提供。 需要使用 gpt-audio 模型，且不支持流式输出（streaming completions）。

items.source: Optional HTTP headers to be added to the chat completion request. To override the api-key you need to use an Authorization header key, and you have to prefix the key value with the Bearer prefix.
items.translation: 可添加到聊天补全请求中的可选 HTTP 请求头。若要覆盖 api-key，您需要使用 Authorization 请求头键，并且必须在键值前加上 Bearer 前缀。

items.source: ChatClient with ToolCallingAdvisor — the recommended approach for most use cases. ToolCallingAdvisor is automatically registered when tools are present and manages the tool-call loop transparently.
items.translation: 带有 ToolCallingAdvisor 的 ChatClient —— 这是大多数用例的推荐方法。ToolCallingAdvisor 在存在工具时会自动注册，并透明地管理工具调用循环。

items.source: You have to specify an audio modality in the OpenAiChatOptions to generate audio output. The AudioParameters class provides the voice and audio format for the audio output.
items.translation: 您必须在 OpenAiChatOptions 中指定 audio 模态以生成音频输出。 AudioParameters 类提供了音频输出的语音和音频格式。

items.source: OpenAI provides custom Structured Outputs APIs that ensure your model generates responses conforming strictly to your provided JSON Schema. In addition to the existing Spring AI model-agnostic Structured Output Converter, these APIs offer enhanced control and precision.
items.translation: OpenAI 提供自定义的 Structured Outputs API，确保您的模型生成的响应严格符合您提供的 JSON Schema。 除了现有的 Spring AI 模型无关的 Structured Output Converter 外，这些 API 还提供了更强的控制力和精确度。

items.source: HTTP layer. An okhttp.requests observation wraps every HTTP attempt to the OpenAI API, carrying HTTP method, URI, status code, and exception tags. Each request also propagates traceparent on the wire to any downstream services (AI gateways, OpenAI-compatible inference servers, proxies).
items.translation: HTTP 层。 一个 okhttp.requests 观测项封装了每一次对 OpenAI API 的 HTTP 请求，携带 HTTP 方法、URI、状态码和异常标签。每个请求还会在传输过程中向任何下游服务（AI 网关、兼容 OpenAI 的推理服务器、代理）传递 traceparent。

items.source: If you need to correlate streaming HTTP spans with their parent chat-model span in your tracing UI, filter by span name okhttp.requests with host api.openai.com and join to the corresponding gen_ai.client.operation span by trace ID or timestamp range. Built-in parent linkage for streaming is being pursued upstream in the OpenAI Java SDK.
items.translation: 如果您需要在追踪 UI 中将流式 HTTP spans 与其父级 chat-model span 相关联，请按 span 名称 okhttp.requests 且 host 为 api.openai.com 进行过滤，并根据 trace ID 或时间戳范围与相应的 gen_ai.client.operation span 进行关联。 针对流式传输的内置父级链接功能正在 OpenAI Java SDK 的上游进行开发中。

items.source: Also note that the extraBody Map is intentionally flattened into the top-level of the JSON request during serialization. So setting extraBody(Map.of("custom_flag", true)) results in {"custom_flag": true} at the root of the JSON payload, matching the behavior of official SDKs.
items.translation: 同时请注意，extraBody Map 在序列化过程中会被有意平铺到 JSON 请求的顶层。因此，设置 extraBody(Map.of("custom_flag", true)) 将导致 JSON 负载的根部出现 {"custom_flag": true}，这与官方 SDK 的行为一致。

items.translation: 回退行为：当服务器未提供 reasoning_content 时（例如官方的 OpenAI Chat Completions），reasoningContent 元数据字段将为空字符串。

items.source: The sampling temperature to use that controls the apparent creativity of generated completions. Higher values will make output more random while lower values will make results more focused and deterministic. It is not recommended to modify temperature and top_p for the same completions request as the interaction of these two settings is difficult to predict.
items.translation: 用于控制生成补全内容表观创造性的采样温度。较高的值会使输出更具随机性，而较低的值则会使结果更集中且具有确定性。不建议在同一个补全请求中同时修改 temperature 和 top_p，因为这两个设置之间的相互作用难以预测。

items.source: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered. We generally recommend altering this or temperature but not both.
items.translation: 一种替代温度采样（sampling with temperature）的方法称为核采样（nucleus sampling），其中模型会考虑概率质量在 top_p 以内的 token 结果。因此，0.1 意味着仅考虑包含前 10% 概率质量的 token。我们通常建议修改其中之一或 temperature，但不要同时修改两者。

items.source: A cache key used by OpenAI to optimize cache hit rates for similar requests. Improves latency and reduces costs. Replaces the deprecated user field for caching purposes. Learn more.
items.translation: OpenAI 用于优化相似请求缓存命中率的缓存键。它能改善延迟并降低成本。它取代了用于缓存目的且已弃用的 user 字段。了解更多信息。

items.source: A stable identifier to help OpenAI detect users violating usage policies. Should be a hashed value (e.g., hashed username or email). Replaces the deprecated user field for safety tracking. Learn more.
items.translation: 一个稳定的标识符，用于帮助 OpenAI 检测违反使用政策的用户。应为哈希值（例如：哈希处理后的用户名或电子邮件）。它取代了已弃用的 user 字段，用于安全追踪。了解更多信息。

items.source: On start-up, the default options can be configured with the OpenAiChatModel(api, options) constructor or the spring.ai.openai.chat.* properties.
items.translation: 在启动时，可以通过 OpenaiChatModel(api, options) 构造函数或 spring.ai.openai.chat.* 属性来配置默认选项。

items.source: You can register custom Java functions with the OpenAiChatModel and have the OpenAI model intelligently choose to output a JSON object containing arguments to call one or many of the registered functions. This is a powerful technique to connect the LLM capabilities with external tools and APIs. Read more about Tool Calling.
items.translation: 您可以在 OpenAiChatModel 中注册自定义的 Java 函数，并让 OpenAI 模型智能选择输出包含调用一个或多个已注册函数的参数的 JSON 对象。 这是将 LLM 能力与外部工具和 API 连接的一种强大技术。 阅读更多关于 Tool Calling 的内容。

items.translation: 无论是同步还是流式工具执行，均使用 ChatClient。 当存在工具时，ToolCallingAdvisor 会自动注册，因此不需要显式的顾问配置。

items.source: OpenAI-compatible inference servers like vLLM, Ollama, and others often support additional parameters beyond those defined in OpenAI’s standard API. For example, these servers may accept parameters such as top_k, repetition_penalty, or other sampling controls that the official OpenAI API does not recognize.
items.translation: 与 OpenAI 兼容的推理服务器（如 vLLM、Ollama 等）通常支持超出 OpenAI 标准 API 定义的额外参数。 例如，这些服务器可能会接受诸如 top_k、repetition_penalty 或其他官方 OpenAI API 无法识别的采样控制参数。

items.source: The extraBody option allows you to pass arbitrary parameters to these servers. Any key-value pairs provided in extraBody are included at the top level of the JSON request, enabling you to leverage server-specific features while using Spring AI’s OpenAI client.
items.translation: extraBody 选项允许您向这些服务器传递任意参数。 在 extraBody 中提供的任何键值对都将包含在 JSON 请求的顶层，让您在调用 Spring AI 的 OpenAI 客户端时能够利用特定服务器的功能。

items.source: The extraBody parameter is intended for use with OpenAI-compatible servers, not the official OpenAI API. The official OpenAI API applies strict validation and will return an HTTP 400 error ("Unknown parameter: 'extra_body'") if unrecognized fields are encountered.
items.translation: extraBody 参数旨在用于与兼容 OpenAI 的服务器配合使用，而非官方 OpenAI API。 官方 OpenAI API 执行严格的验证，如果遇到无法识别的字段，将返回 HTTP 400 错误 ("Unknown parameter: 'extra_body'")。

items.source: If you are communicating with the official OpenAI API, you should never populate the extraBody parameter.
items.translation: 如果您正在与官方 OpenAI API 进行通信，您绝不应该填充 extraBody 参数。

items.source: The extraBody parameter accepts any Map<String, Object>, allowing you to pass whatever parameters your target server supports. Spring AI does not validate these parameters—they are passed directly to the server. This design provides maximum flexibility for working with diverse OpenAI-compatible implementations.
items.translation: extraBody 参数接受任何 Map<String, Object>，允许您传递目标服务器支持的任何参数。 Spring AI 不会对这些参数进行校验——它们将直接传递给服务器。 这种设计为处理各种兼容 OpenAI 的实现提供了最大的灵活性。
